title: Third Shot World
style: world big band, female lead vocal, brass and kora, walking bass, 88 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, uplifting choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
The third shot is the bridge.
Power to patience.
In every language, same truth.

[VERSE 1 - English]
After the serve comes the third shot
Not a power hit, it's the arc you've got
Float it soft over the net
Land it in the kitchen, that's the reset

[VERSE 2 - Hausa transliteration]
Bayan hidimar sai harbi na uku
Ba karfi ba, sai layin da kake da shi
Tunkuda shi a hankali akan raga
Sauka cikin kicin, wannan shine sake farawa

[VERSE 3 - Finnish]
Syoton jalkeen tulee kolmas laukaus
Ei voimaiskua, vaan se kaari jota sinulla on
Kellu se pehmeasti verkon yli
Laske se keittiolle, se on nollaus

[CHORUS]
THIRD SHOT - HARBI NA UKU - KOLMAS
FLOAT IT SOFT - LAND IT SHORT
THIRD SHOT WORLD - EVERY COURT
ARC AND PATIENCE - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Khmer transliteration]
Boh baan del tri, mean vithee tuk
Min men kmoang, men kambang del anak mean
Boh va yeung pham anh
Chol knong phtaeh baay, nih chhoh thmei

[VERSE 5 - Serbian transliteration]
Posle servisa dolazi treci udarac
Ne udaraj jako, to je luk koji imas
Pusti ga meko preko mreze
Spusti u kuhinju, to je pocetak

[VERSE 6 - Catalan]
Despres del servei ve el tercer cop
No es un cop de potencia, es l'arc que tens
Fes-lo flotar suaument sobre la xarxa
Aterra a la cuina, aixi es reinicia

[CHORUS]
THIRD SHOT - HARBI NA UKU - KOLMAS
FLOAT IT SOFT - LAND IT SHORT
THIRD SHOT WORLD - EVERY COURT
ARC AND PATIENCE - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Hausa. Finnish. Khmer. Serbian. Catalan.
Every language knows the same shot.
Soft. High arc. Short landing.
Third shot drop. Everywhere.

[FINAL CHORUS]
THIRD SHOT - HARBI NA UKU - KOLMAS
FLOAT IT SOFT - LAND IT SHORT
THIRD SHOT WORLD - EVERY COURT
ARC AND PATIENCE - EVERY TIME
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE ARC
FLOAT IT HOME - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
One drop. Every world.
Third shot. Always.
